//: The connector packages Phoenix comes with (docs/SYNERGY-CONNECTORS.md 7, 'What comes with Phoenix'): installed in the image as apps the user may remove (/media/cryptofs/apps; tools/install-rootfs.py, phoenix-sim's and tools/serve-rootfs.py's installed apps, runtime/rootfs.json 'preinstalled'), counted by the Marketplace as installed from the catalog sourceId, and installed again from it without Developer Mode (packagesservice.js firstPartyEntry).

from: where the package's app is in this checkout (for the tools that build the image and the simulator); service and templates: its connector service and account templates, for the simulator's runtime.

Google, Microsoft and LoRa mesh join this list when they are built. Unofficial Telegram is here, and works in a build with Telegram's app id and TDLib (meta-phoenix phoenix-tdjson); elsewhere its sign-in page says it is not available in this build.

firstParty: Phoenix's own connector packages that do not come with it but are in its catalog (apps/connectors/: not apps of the image or the simulator; bin/serve.sh uploads them to a development catalog): installed by those who want them, from a Phoenix catalog the device ships with, without Developer Mode, as a pre-installed one is installed again (packagesservice.js firstPartyEntry). from, service and templates as above, for the simulator.
